name: Capital B
summary: Capital B, along with its affiliated companies, is dedicated to crafting and promoting blockchain solutions globally, with operations spanning France and international markets. The firm also offers services for integrating blockchain technologies and provides expert consulting in both IT and marketing. Furthermore, Capital B extends its expertise to professional training and advisory support, and manages digital marketing efforts to power its Shopbot platform. Its portfolio also encompasses Enterprise Systems Management (ESM) consulting within the IT sector, specifically tailored for data science applications. Founded in 2008, Capital B's headquarters are situated in Puteaux, France.
